parameters.content:
## TBW 2026 — Single Meta trigger, separate editable logic
01–08 Routing/language/navigation • 09 Appointment • 10 Our Services • 11 Human • 12 Error/invalid input.
03-minute nudge + 20-minute timeout ONLY; NO appointment reminder.
Booking DATE only + daily 001–100; team sets call time manually.
Google Sheets: existing Appointments and WhatsApp Leads.
Keep INACTIVE until controlled handover.
Owner personal alert: Cloud API free-form delivery requires recipient 24h conversation window or approved template.
V2 FIX: Appointments worksheet selection corrected; Google OAuth must be reconnected in n8n; failed Sheets reads DO NOT create Calendar events or claim success.
The scheduler running every minute is intentional. No pending session = zero WhatsApp sends. No automatic pre-appointment reminders.

parameters.content:
## FAST RESPONSE + DNS-ONLY RETRY
- Customer send FIRST. Owner alert AFTER response, never blocking reply.
- No HTTP Request auto-retry. Only confirmed DNS lookup failures eligible for delayed retry.
- Outbound queue in workflow static data is BEST-EFFORT; it is NOT a transactional durable outbox. For production exactly-once semantics use database idempotency + reconciliation.
- Import INACTIVE. Do not activate alongside the original WhatsApp trigger.
- After import, connect the separate error monitor in workflow Settings.
- Google OAuth must be connected in n8n. Verify data sheets before activation.
- Scheduler is required for the retry process.
- Timer messages are never auto-retried (avoids late spam).
